主要内容: Ulta Beauty is leveraging brand partnerships to enhance its makeup sales, which declined from the previous year. Cosmetics represented 43% of Ulta's total sales in fiscal year 2021, the largest segment, but dipped from the prior year. The company highlighted collaborations with brands like Olaplex, Fenty, and Supergoop to improve performance in its flagship segment. CEO Dave Kimbell noted that makeup sales have been more volatile and lagged behind other categories post-Covid. Net sales rose 40% year-over-year to $8.6 billion, matching Wall Street expectations. Ulta also expanded its Target partnership, opening over 100 stores and aiming for 250 more. The loyalty program, Ultamate Rewards, gained 4 million members, reaching 37 million. The company's diversity initiative supports BIPOC-owned brands, including Fenty. Looking ahead, Ulta expects EPS between $18.20 and $18.70 on revenue of $9.05 billion to $9.15 billion in fiscal 2022.
